title: Carbon Offset Disclosure for Residential Natural Gas Supply Plans
content:
The Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas plans of Residential Natural Gas Supply match the combustion emissions of the customer's gas usage with retired carbon offsets. The other five plans carry no offsets.

| Plan | Share of gas usage matched with retired offsets | Offset registry standard | Metric tons of CO2e offset per therm billed | Annual statement of offsets retired |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | 0% | none | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | 0% | none | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | 0% | none | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 0% | none | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 0% | none | 0.0000 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | 100% | Verra Verified Carbon Standard | 0.0053 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 100% | Verra Verified Carbon Standard | 0.0053 | Yes |

The offset quantity is stated per therm billed, to four decimal places. A plan whose registry standard reads "none" carries no offsets.

### Illustration (hypothetical usage)

A household on Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 billed 100 therms in a year: the offsets retired for that usage are 100 therms multiplied by 0.0053, that is 0.53 metric tons of CO2e, and the customer receives an annual statement of the offsets retired. The same 100 therms on Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 carry 0.0000 tons and no statement.
